series.zh: 学习与职业：AI 时代成长

title.en: Learn AI skills as career compounding, not a crash course.
title.zh: 把 AI 技能当作职业复利，而不是速成课。

subtitle.en: A career-video lesson on explaining learning plans, job readiness, and skill transfer with calm professional English.
subtitle.zh: 一节职业视频表达课：用稳定专业英语讲学习计划、求职准备和技能迁移。

audience: Career changer · Early-career professional · AI learner

source.title: How to use AI for your job search | Google Career Certificates
source.speaker: Google Career Certificates
source.channel: Grow with Google / Google Career Certificates

note.en: Selected from recent Grow with Google learning and career-search topics. This lesson distills the recurring career theme: build durable skills, show evidence, and narrate transferable experience.
note.zh: 选自最近 Grow with Google 学习与求职主题。本课提炼反复出现的职业主线：建立长期技能、展示证据、讲清可迁移经验。

scenario.customer: A learner says they want to move into AI quickly but feels overwhelmed by tools, certificates, portfolio projects, and job descriptions.
scenario.weakResponse: You should take an AI course, learn prompt engineering, and apply to AI jobs.
scenario.reliableResponse: I would treat this as a skills-compounding plan. Pick one job direction, map the skills behind it, build small proof projects, and use each project to show how your existing experience transfers into AI-enabled work.

principle.en: Career change becomes credible when learning produces evidence.
principle.zh: 当学习产出证据时，职业转型才可信。

flow.en: Start with a target role instead of a vague desire to learn AI.
flow.zh: 先确定目标岗位，而不是泛泛地想学 AI。

flow.en: Translate the role into skill clusters: tools, judgment, communication, and domain knowledge.
flow.zh: 把岗位翻译成技能群：工具、判断、沟通和领域知识。

flow.en: Build proof through small projects that resemble real work.
flow.zh: 通过接近真实工作的项目建立证据。

flow.en: Narrate transferable experience with examples, not adjectives.
flow.zh: 用例子讲可迁移经验，而不是用形容词自夸。

flow.en: Iterate: learn, build, publish, ask for feedback, revise.
flow.zh: 循环迭代：学习、构建、发布、寻求反馈、修改。

phraseBank.line: I am not trying to learn AI in general; I am building the skills required for this specific role.

why.en: It makes the learner sound intentional and job-aware.
why.zh: 让学习者显得有方向，也理解岗位。

intent.zh: 把课程和证据连接起来。

phraseBank.line: The certificate helped me structure the learning; the project shows how I can apply it.

why.en: It avoids treating credentials as the whole story.
why.zh: 避免把证书当成全部故事。

phraseBank.line: My previous role trained me to understand messy user needs, which is directly relevant to AI product work.

why.en: It converts old experience into future value.
why.zh: 把旧经验转换成未来价值。

meaning.en: The way small learning investments build value over time.
meaning.zh: 小的学习投入随时间累积成职业价值。

use.en: Career compounding is slower than hype, but more durable.
use.zh: Career compounding 比 hype 慢，但更持久。

meaning.en: A small project that demonstrates a skill in a practical context.
meaning.zh: 在实际语境中展示技能的小项目。

use.en: A proof project gives an interviewer something concrete to evaluate.
use.zh: Proof project 给面试官一个具体可评估的东西。

meaning.en: Useful in a new role or context, even if learned elsewhere.
meaning.zh: 即使从别处学来，也能用于新岗位或新语境。

use.en: Transferable skills become powerful when you explain the connection.
use.zh: 当你讲清连接时，可迁移技能才有力量。

meaning.en: Prepared to perform the practical work a role requires.
meaning.zh: 准备好完成岗位所需的实际工作。

use.en: Job-ready does not mean perfect; it means able to contribute and keep learning.
use.zh: Job-ready 不是完美，而是能贡献并继续学习。

logicMoves.line: I would not try to learn every tool at once. I would choose a role, identify the skill gaps, and build evidence one project at a time.

why.en: It gives overwhelmed learners a calm structure.
why.zh: 给焦虑的学习者一个稳定结构。

logicMoves.line: The learning matters more when it leaves a trail: notes, demos, decisions, and revisions.

why.en: It turns private study into public evidence.
why.zh: 把私下学习变成公开证据。

logicMoves.line: The credential can open the conversation, but the project has to carry the credibility.

why.en: It keeps credentials useful without overvaluing them.
why.zh: 保留证书价值，但不过度依赖。

conversationLessons.en: Career videos often sound useful when they turn vague motivation into visible next steps.
conversationLessons.zh: 职业视频有用的地方，是把模糊动力变成可见下一步。

conversationLessons.en: The best learning narrative is not I studied hard. It is I learned, applied, measured, and revised.
conversationLessons.zh: 最好的学习叙事不是“我很努力”，而是“我学习、应用、衡量、修改”。

conversationLessons.en: For AI careers, communication is part of the skill, not decoration around the skill.
conversationLessons.zh: 对 AI 职业来说，沟通就是技能的一部分，不是技能外面的装饰。

anchor.phrase: the project shows how I can apply it
anchor.quote: The certificate structures the learning; the project proves the application.

concept.en: Career English becomes stronger when every claim is attached to a piece of evidence.
concept.zh: 职业英语最有力的时候，是每个主张都绑定一个证据。

examples.line: I built this project to practice the exact workflow I would be expected to support in the role.

why.en: It connects the project directly to job readiness.
why.zh: 把项目直接连接到岗位准备度。

examples.line: I am still early, but I can show how my judgment improved between version one and version two.

why.en: It is honest and still evidence-based.
why.zh: 诚实，同时仍然基于证据。

examples.line: My background is not a detour; it gives me domain context that helps me ask better AI questions.

why.en: It turns a nontraditional path into an advantage.
why.zh: 把非传统路径转成优势。

lines.line: I am focusing on AI-enabled product work, so I am learning the tools, workflows, and communication patterns that role requires.

why.en: It is specific enough to sound serious.
why.zh: 足够具体，因此显得认真。

lines.line: The course gave me structure, but I used the project to test whether I could apply the ideas in a realistic setting.

why.en: It separates learning input from applied output.
why.zh: 区分了学习输入和应用输出。

lines.line: I am not presenting myself as finished; I am showing that I can learn, apply feedback, and improve the work.

why.en: It sounds humble without sounding weak.

intent.en: Connect past role to AI work.
intent.zh: 把过去岗位连接到 AI 工作。

lines.line: The transferable part of my experience is understanding user problems before choosing a technical solution.

why.en: It makes non-AI experience relevant to AI product judgment.
why.zh: 让非 AI 经验变得和 AI 产品判断相关。

lines.line: My next step is to keep turning learning into visible work that hiring teams can evaluate.

why.en: It ends with a concrete, accountable plan.
why.zh: 用具体负责的计划收尾。

prompt.en: Practice explaining your AI learning plan in a career conversation.
prompt.zh: 练习在职业对话中解释你的 AI 学习计划。

steps.en: Someone asks why you are learning AI now.
steps.zh: 有人问你为什么现在学 AI。

focus.en: Tie learning to a role, not a trend.
focus.zh: 把学习绑定到岗位，而不是趋势。

steps.en: An interviewer asks what your certificate proves.
steps.zh: 面试官问你的证书证明了什么。

focus.zh: 区分学习结构和实际应用。

steps.en: You need to explain a nontraditional background.
steps.zh: 你需要解释非传统背景。

focus.en: Turn prior experience into transferable judgment.
focus.zh: 把过去经验转成可迁移判断力。
